verdict.rationale: The bring-your-own-keys half is clearly documented. Open WebUI connects to any OpenAI-compatible provider via a custom Base URL, and it can use existing Codex/Claude Code/Cursor subscriptions as native chat backends without an API key. Nothing in the evidence shows token usage or cost tracking per model or per conversation, which is half the story. Missing for 10: token usage reporting, cost tracking per model, per-conversation usage/cost views, independent corroboration.
